questions.question: How does Isaiah 1 describe the nation of Judah?
options: A small and weak nation, sorely oppressed by its many neighbors
A wealthy and prosperous nation, secure in its very great riches
A sinful nation, laden with iniquity, having forsaken the LORD
A righteous nation, ever faithful to the LORD and his covenant
questions.answer: A sinful nation, laden with iniquity, having forsaken the LORD

questions.question: What does God invite the people to do in Isaiah 1?
options: 'Bring me yet more sacrifices and feasts'; only then will I turn aside and hear all your prayers
'Flee away from the city at once'; for my judgment has already fallen heavily upon this whole place
'Depart far from me, you sinners'; for your guilt is now far too great for me to ever once pardon
'Come now, let us reason together'; though sins be like scarlet, they shall be white as snow
questions.answer: 'Come now, let us reason together'; though sins be like scarlet, they shall be white as snow

questions.question: God says he is weary of empty sacrifices when the people's hands are full of blood.
Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as _____.
Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean; stop doing evil; learn to do _____.
